english.title: Permit use of vehicle without lights at night / in reduced visibility
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) permitted **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), whilst it was in motion at a time between

(A)_[sunset and sunrise]_
(B)_[sunset and sunrise in seriously reduced visibility]_

when **(..SPECIFY FRONT/REAR POSITION, REAR REGISTRATION PLATE, SIDE/END-OUTLINE MARKER LAMP(S)..) required to be fitted by the Road Vehicles Lighting Regulations 1989

(C)_[was]_
(D)_[were]_

not kept lit and unobscured
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 24(1)(a) of the Road Vehicles Lighting Regulations 1989, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
permitted use on a road of a vehicle in motion between sunset and sunrise OR
sunrise and sunset in seriously reduced visibility
when the front/rear position lamp(s)/rear registration plate lamp(s)/
side marker lamp(s)/end-outline marker lamp(s)
which were required was/were not kept lit and unobscured

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See regulation 24 for application to other vehicles.
(ii) See regulation 25(5) and (9) for exceptions.
(iii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iv) See also offence wordings: H3235 and H3236.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale (level four if goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers).

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
